items.title: Wallace Davenport Interview, 1995-11-14
items.q: Well Earl was in my harmony class and he was in my sight singing class.

ctx.x: Yeah. Well Earl was in my harmony class and he was in my sight singing class. And I would teach them how to read rhythms. And he was very good at it. But I was the only one at the school who was teaching rhythms. You know like they would teach the rhythm along with the melody. But they depend upon the ear. But when you're reading rhythm you're not making any notes, you're just playing the rhythm. He was one of my best students.
